questions.text:
Thanks for agreeing to help!
Two nights ago, right in the middle of our dinner, his phone rang and he stepped outside for a good thirty minutes.
Who called him during our dinner?
questions.hint: Look for "Dinner out — Vacation Week" in the Calendar app, then check the call history for whoever rang him that day.

questions.text:
An assistant right in his office building, yet he's never once mentioned her name at home.
He sometimes goes out after work with people from the office. I bet she's been there too.
Where have they met up after work with someone else from the office?
questions.hint: Check WhatsApp for his conversation with his colleague Curtis Vance. They set up after-work drinks with Tessa, so read to the end to see which place they went to.

questions.text:
So there's afterwork drinks too, and still not a word about her from him.
One evening he told me he had a client dinner and didn't get home till late.
What's the name of the place he actually went to a week ago, on the night of that client dinner?
questions.hint: Check the Calendar for a dinner a week ago, then look in his Email. Both name the same place.

questions.text:
Twenty.
I genuinely don't know what to do with that number.
I have a feeling he's been buying her things.
What did he get her?
questions.hint: Go to Messages and find the conversation with Tessa, then make the connection with Wallet

questions.text:
Seriously?
It'll be the last straw if he's spending more on her than he does on me.
How much exactly did he spend on those plane tickets?
questions.hint: Check Wallet for reservation number A347529 — it's tied to a charge on his Chase Bank card, that'll show you the cost.

questions.text:
Six grand, spent on her.
He takes so many of these trips I've lost count of them all.
When's he supposed to be back from this trip?
questions.hint: Check the calendar for whatever day is marked "Return".

questions.text:
I cannot believe this...
He's spending our actual wedding anniversary with her.
Please, what's the exact name of their hotel in Denver?
questions.hint: Open Maps and search for the pinned hotel in Denver.

onboarding.text: Hello... I'm Diane. A friend of mine said you're the person people come to when they're where I am now. I need that help, and I can't wait.
onboarding.label: Diane

onboarding.text: Roland is my husband. There's the three of us — him, me, and our little boy Owen. A close family, I'd have said. That's what I believed, anyway.
onboarding.label: Diane & Roland

onboarding.text: For a year it's been late nights, client dinners, trips away. Two nights ago his phone went at dinner and he took it outside. Half an hour. I think there's someone else
onboarding.label: Roland

onboarding.text: This morning, he left his phone on the hall table. He occasionally goes on business trips, and there's even one booked right over our anniversary. I keep hoping I'm mistaken. Just give it to me straight
onboarding.label: Diane

msgs.text: Hi Roland! Hope all is well with you
Tessa! Good to hear from you
You too! Things have been crazy for me lately
How's everything at the office?
It's fine, just as stressful as always but whatever
What about you? How are the kids?
All good here, Owen is shooting up fast
Oh I bet! Anyway...
I've got something for you
Oh yeah? What's that?
A little surprise
Now you've got me curious
Could I swing by and drop it off tonight?
Sure! What time were you thinking?
Does 7pm work for you?
Perfect
Alright, see you later then!
See you tonight
Hey! I'm downstairs
Coming!
Thanks so much for tonight
Anytime! Hope you'll enjoy it
I'm dying to see what it is
Tessa... this is amazing
So you like it?
Thanks for this wonderful gift. The number is A347529 right?
Yep that's the one! Good eye
😊 Good night Roland
Hey cousin, anything locked in for the weekend?
Hey! Wide open so far
Feel like getting out on the course Sunday morning?
Now you're talking. Which course?
Broadmoor, where else
Works for me. Tee off at 9?
Make it 9:30, no need to be up at dawn
😄 done, 9:30 it is
Are you booking the tee time or should I?
I'll ring the pro shop, the membership is in my name
Perfect. And bring the good driver this time
That one is retired and you know it 😄
Oh and the new girlfriend wants the four of us to grab dinner sometime
Wait, since when are you seeing anyone?!
Barely three weeks in, still very new
Does she have a name?
Coreen. She's in advertising
Nice one! Dinner sounds good to me
Awesome, I'll throw a few dates your way
Roland! Quick one, how are you?
Marissa! All good here, and you?
Can't complain. I'm in Seattle next week actually
Oh that's great! Can we meet up?
For sure! Tuesday or Wednesday evening?
Let's say Tuesday
Nice. Somewhere near the water suit you?
Yeah that works, got a spot in mind?
The Walrus and the Carpenter, ever been?
Heard good things! 7:30?
7:30 is good. Do you want to book or shall I?
I'll call them, they fill up fast midweek
Worth asking for a table outside?
Always, if the weather holds
Locked in. It'll be so good to see you
Same here! See you Tuesday
Roland, hate to bug you this late
You're never a bother Ruby. What's up?
Got a package for you, delivery guy buzzed my place instead
Oh nice, mind if I swing by tonight to grab it?
Sure thing, I'm around until 7
Great, I'll knock about 6:30
Sounds good, see you then
Forget it! Neighbors look out for each other
You saved me there Ruby, thanks again!
Roland! Did that piece on Vertexis in the Financial Times reach you?
Not yet, what's it about?
It's all about how much you grew in 2025
Ha, hoping it's a flattering one 😅
Yeah, really solid! Revenue up 23%
Brilliant. Good of you to flag it
Hey, we still good for Thursday?
Absolutely! That little Italian place near the office, right?
Yep, 8 o'clock like we said
Great, Thursday it is!
Hi Roland, I've come down with something so Wednesday is off
Ugh, sorry to hear it. Rest up
Sorry about that. Any chance we do Friday, same time?
Friday at 6 works for me
Have you got balls or shall I bring a fresh tube?
Bring a tube, mine are completely flat
Will do. Court 3 is held for us until 7
Plenty of time, thanks Kip
Great. Keep drilling that backhand until then 😉
😄 you got it, coach!
Mr. Whitlock, quick reminder that Owen is booked in tomorrow at 3pm
Noted, thank you Dr Kowalczyk!
Hi, your Uber Eats delivery is about 5 minutes away
Great, heading down now
No rush, I'm waiting out front
Hi Roland, your number came from Diane
Hi Alina! She mentioned you'd be in touch
Something about needing a sitter for Owen?
That's the one. Just the odd evening here and there
Sounds good to me. Could we sit down and talk it through?
Definitely. Would the weekend suit?
Does Saturday afternoon work?
Great, come by ours at 3?
Will do, I'll get the address off Diane
Yo! How's things, Roland?
Dean! All fine here, you?
Can't complain. Anything on Saturday night?
Nothing on the calendar, what's up?
Having a few people over at mine
Count me in. What time?
Doors at 8, drinks first then we'll order food in
Nice. Want me to bring anything?
I'll bring a bottle of wine if you want
Done, I'll sort it
Something red if you can, nobody else ever brings any
There's a Saint-Émilion in the rack with your name on it
Now I'm properly looking forward to it
Consider it packed
Sweet, Saturday it is
Mr. Whitlock, would this afternoon suit for me to look at that leak?
That works. What sort of time?
Anywhere from 2 to 4, if that's alright?
Fine by me, I'll be home
Evening Mr. Whitlock, your prescription is in and ready to collect
Evening Roland! I'm away on a training course, so no yoga tomorrow
That's fine Nina, enjoy the course!
Thanks! Back to the usual slot Monday
Great, make the most of it
Hi Roland, you're confirmed for Friday at 4
Lovely, thanks Coreen. Friday then
Hi Roland!
Bethany! How's it going?
Really good thanks! And you?
Fine, the usual work grind
I get it... anyway
Your son turns six in May, doesn't he?
Yep, exactly! Great memory
I had him in mind for my niece's birthday
They're the same age, aren't they?
Oh right, that's true! Leah, correct?
Exactly! Would you like Owen to join?
When's it happening?
August 8, on a Saturday afternoon
Should work, I'll check and get back to you
Perfect! No pressure at all
It'll be a good time for them
Yeah, they really get along
Gotta run, meeting in 5min
Go for it! Talk soon
Catch you later Roland!
Bye!
Oh by the way, Saturday is a go!
Awesome! Thank you Roland 😊
Cousin! Are you free this weekend or booked solid?
Hey! Pretty open this weekend
What's up?
A pair of tickets to the Sounders-Timbers game Sunday just landed in my lap
You in?
Feels like forever since I watched one from the stands
Nice! Say 2pm at the light rail station?
Deal, the beers are on me
Haha same as always 😄
So how's work treating you?
Same grind as ever, pretty heavy stretch right now
Closing out the year-end budgets...
Chin up, cousin!
The game'll be good for you, take your mind off it
Hope so! See you Sunday 👍
Roland, sorry to interrupt your evening
The delivery guy's out here trying to find your unit
He keeps buzzing my unit instead of yours
Ruby! Good of you to say something
On my way down now
Great, I've asked him to hang on
Really appreciate it, thank you
Roland, does Thursday at 6 work for you?
Kip! Thursday is fine by me
Still want to keep drilling that backhand?
That's the plan, plus some work coming into the net
You've come a long way, stick with it
Thanks! Can't wait to see it come together
Court 3 like usual?
Perfect! See you Thursday
Roland, does our old econ teacher ring any bells?
The bearded one who never once sat down?
Yeah! Bumped into him this morning
He has aged a bit 😅
Haha none of us are getting younger!
Did he actually recognize you?
Instantly! The man forgets nothing
He even asked how you've been
Oh nice, what'd you tell him?
That you were a big shot in finance over in Seattle now 😄
He was really happy for you
Ha, he always said we'd land on our feet
He asked if you still play golf as badly as you did at 17
I told him better, but not by much 😄
Thanks for that, remind me to return the favor
He wasn't wrong. Decent teacher after all
We should get everyone together for dinner soon
Count me in, I'll send over a few free evenings
Sorted. Have a good one, dude
Hi, your delivery's set for between 12 and 2 today
Works for me, I'll be home. Thanks!
Roland! How are you keeping?
We haven't spoken in forever
Marissa! Doing well thanks
Way too long, you're right!
So how's the new job treating you?
Honestly great, the team is brilliant
What about you, still with Vertexis?
Still there and still happy!
Plenty of work, but I wouldn't swap it
Nice! Let's grab lunch one of these weeks
Yes please. I'll send over some slots next week
Mr. Whitlock, we've got you down for August 5 at 3:30 PM
Hi Roland, it was Shelby who passed on your number
She said you were after a decent Indian place?
Hi Alina! That's right
You know a good one?
I know exactly the one, the little Indian kitchen by the market
Proper home cooking and it barely dents your wallet
Perfect. Do you have the street address?
812 5th Ave, right by the corner
Ask them for the table in the window 😉
Brilliant, thanks for the steer
Any time! Tell me how you get on
Roland, word from Diane is that you need an electrician?
I know a really good guy if you want the number
Dean! She's not wrong
Got a few outlets that need redoing
Can you send me his info?
Here you go, the electrician: +1 (206) 892-4531
He did my whole place, flawless work
And didn't gouge me either
Brilliant, thanks so much
I'll give him a ring tomorrow
He usually has a slot inside the week too
Even better, the kitchen outlets are the urgent ones
I'll see what he says
Just tell him I sent you
That should smooth the way
Got it. Thanks again 👍
Hey Roland!
How are you? How'd your day go?
Hey Curtis! Doing great. Thanks!
Hectic day like always
And you?
Same, I had a discussion that dragged on and on
Oh hey, guess what?
What?
I bumped into Tessa yesterday
She proposed the three of us meet up after work
Ah nice!
It's been ages since we all got together
Right! I agreed on the spot
Maybe we could do next Thursday?
Thursday's good for me
Got a spot in mind?
How about the back bar at Canon? We checked it out last year
The one with the great background music?
That's the one
Oh yeah! Perfect
I'll confirm with Tessa tomorrow
And I'll let you know about the time
Really looking forward to seeing you guys!
Me too! Have a great evening Roland
Tessa's in. Thursday at 6:30, back bar at Canon
Great, see you both there
Good to catch up with you and Tessa at Canon tonight
Same here. Let's not wait so long next time
Oh Roland, did you get a chance to look at the Q1 numbers? The boss wants to present them Monday
